summary: Comprehensive testing of DDYs Compliance as a Service platform. Backend APIs working well (93.8% success rate), but critical frontend routing and authentication issues identified.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 Not Found when accessing tenant-specific MI stats
minor_bugs.impact: MI dashboard may not show tenant-specific metrics

critical_bugs.issue: Maker user (maker@ddys.com) is incorrectly redirected to /admin instead of /workspace/cases
critical_bugs.impact: DDYS_RCM_MAKER role users cannot access their intended workspace

critical_bugs.issue: Maker users see 'No tenants yet' in admin dashboard despite having tenant_roles in API response
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot access tenant-specific data even when properly authenticated

ui_bugs.issue: Cases table shows 'Loading...' indefinitely when tenant context is not set
User sessions appear to expire quickly, redirecting to login page

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about HTML structure (span inside tbody)

passed_tests: Admin navigation (tenants, users, settings, policy pages)
Screening API endpoints (sanctions, PEP, adverse media)
All major API endpoints responding correctly

critical_fixes: Fix login redirect logic in frontend to properly route DDYS_RCM_MAKER users to /workspace/cases instead of /admin
Fix tenant context loading for non-admin users to ensure they can access their assigned tenant data
Investigate and fix cases pipeline loading issue when tenant context is missing
recommended_fixes: Implement proper session timeout handling with refresh token mechanism
Fix MI tenant stats endpoint (404 error)
Address HTML structure warnings in admin dashboard
